entities.name: Wendy Bowman
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wendy Bowman was an Australian farmer and environmentalist in New South Wales who successfully campaigned to prevent Yancoal from developing coal mining in the Hunter Valley. In recognition of her efforts, she was awarded the Goldman Environmental Prize in 2017.
